races.name: Mortal Bunny Rum Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Juggernaut
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent placed form but faces the tactical challenge of making ground on a lone leader
runners_data.comment: Doesn't look that well treated despite recent placings but should give his running
runners_data.spotlight: Reliable type who has finished runner-up at Fontwell (2m1f, good) and Stratford (3m2f, good) this spring; he was beaten 7l and 9l in those races under James Robottom and he's off the same mark as last time.

runners_data.name: Red Rubio
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the trip extension and his point-to-point background helps on testing ground over this marathon distance
runners_data.comment: From off the pace he was an encouraging third on handicap debut; raised in distance
runners_data.spotlight: 3m point winner; from off the pace he was an encouraging third on handicap debut at Hereford (2m, good) and this longer trip looks sure to benefit him; considered.

runners_data.name: Aslukgoes
runners_data.note: Long absence of 168 days is a major concern for a prominent runner who needs to be sharp from the start
runners_data.comment: Useful at best but quiet for current yard and softening ground would be a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Good bumper form (three wins, including Listed) and a novice hurdle winner (all on good); nowhere near that level in two handicaps for current yard and cheekpieces are now turned to; the prospect of softening ground is a further concern.

runners_data.name: October Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with poor winning record (0-11) who has struggled in handicap company and may find this grade too tough
runners_data.comment: 0-11 under rules and has been beaten about 15l in her two handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who is 0-11 under rules and has been beaten about 15l in her two handicaps; unwise to rate her subsequent placed form in maidens as improvement; cheekpieces tried last time are removed.

runners_data.name: Lemon Leaf
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to face no early pressure and his course-and-distance win gives him a significant edge
runners_data.comment: Took a 10lb hit for recent C&D success but he looks progressive
runners_data.spotlight: They only jumped four hurdles when this lightly raced 6yo made a successful handicap debut over C&D, winning by just under 4l; took a 10lb hit for that but he looks progressive.

runners_data.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical challenge but his back-to-back course wins and good recent form make him the main danger
runners_data.comment: Back over this trip he's gone back-to-back in course handicaps; up 5lb for last time
runners_data.spotlight: Back over this trip he's gone back-to-back in course handicaps (good ground; placed on soft), last time nicely on top in the finish; up another 5lb but looks sure to be involved.

races.paceDynamic: Lemon Leaf holds a monopoly on early pace with his confirmed leading style, while the other five are all prominent/hold-up types who will settle behind. This creates a dream scenario for the front-runner, as he faces no early pressure and can dictate terms throughout the 2m4f journey on soft ground that will emphasize stamina. The lack of pace pressure means Lemon Leaf can cruise through the early stages and kick when ready, while the pack behind will need to rely on late finishing speed. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and those with proven stamina reserves over horses dependent on turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lemon Leaf Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Lemon Leaf gets his preferred soft lead without harassment from the flag
scenarios.body: He can measure out his fractions perfectly and have plenty left for the finish, making the pursuers chase a moving target. The longer they leave it to challenge, the more ground they concede to a horse already proven at this course and distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Successful
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and steady pace allows closers to unleash finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Lion Of The Desert and Red Rubio can use their hold-up/prominent styles to good effect, timing late runs to collar a tiring leader. The 2m4f trip suits both stamina types on testing ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit close enough to Lemon Leaf without being strung out
scenarios.body: Juggernaut or October Hill could track the leader into the straight and have enough left to pass in the final furlong. Their experience of sitting handy positions gives them the tactical edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lemon Leaf goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The whole field arrives together and it becomes about who has the most natural speed rather than stamina. Aslukgoes could benefit from his point-to-point background in a rough finish.

watchPoints.text: Lemon Leaf getting an uncontested lead through the first mile could make this a procession
Red Rubio's stamina reserves on soft ground as the trip steps up significantly from his recent shorter efforts
October Hill's jumping under pressure if she gets competitive, given her poor strike rate and tendency to find trouble
Aslukgoes showing ring-rust after 168 days off, particularly important for a horse who needs to be handy from the start
Lion Of The Desert's ability to get into contention from his hold-up style if the pace becomes truly pedestrian

races.name: Happy 1st Birthday Donnacha Fenelon Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Brenda Lady
runners_data.note: Lightly raced newcomer to hurdles with unknown running style and breeding suggests staying ability
runners_data.comment: Appealing pedigree but this is a belated racecourse debut
runners_data.spotlight: Eleventh foal; sister to bumper/2m5f hurdle winner Far Sight, half-sister to five winners including Dare To Endeavour (useful 2m4f-3m chase), Holly James (bumper/2m hurdle) and Grand Enterprise (2m2f/3m hurdle); dam 2m-2m5f hurdle winner; appealing pedigree but this is a belated racecourse debut.

runners_data.name: The Flaggy Shore
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with Listed form who can control tempo and has 74 days freshness
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who won a Warwick bumper by 7l and contested two Listed races since then, finishing second on the first occasion; promising recruit to hurdling.

runners_data.name: Fiskardo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from long absence but won last start at Perth with tongue-tie fitted
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner last month but others in here did have superior form in that scene
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a long absence to edge home in a good-ground bumper at Perth last month (first run in a tongue-tie); others in here did have superior form in that scene.

runners_data.name: Kenobi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor hurdles record including pulled-up efforts, makes little appeal
runners_data.comment: Pulled up or tailed off in his three runs over hurdles and holds no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up or tailed off in his three runs over hurdles and makes very little appeal.

runners_data.name: One Knight
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with proven bumper form but disappointed when stepped up in grade at Aintree
runners_data.spotlight: Won his first two bumpers for this yard under Cameron Johnstone-Baker (good to soft/good) before disappointing in a Grade 2 at the Grand National meeting; could easily be up to this on his hurdling debut.

races.paceDynamic: The Flaggy Shore will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field. One Knight may track prominently early but isn't a natural leader, while Fiskardo and Kenobi will need to be delivered late. With only one genuine front-runner, The Flaggy Shore can control the tempo and dictate when to inject pace. This measured tempo followed by a sprint finish clearly favours horses that can travel and quicken, giving prominent racers and those with tactical speed a significant advantage over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If The Flaggy Shore gets an uncontested lead and controls fractions
scenarios.body: The proven bumper winner can dictate ideal fractions and has the class edge from his Listed placings. His natural speed advantage becomes decisive when he can control when the race begins in earnest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If One Knight travels smoothly in second and produces his bumper form
scenarios.body: The Emma Lavelle runner showed good acceleration winning his first two bumpers and can capitalize on tracking the pace. His proven partnership with Johnstone-Baker becomes crucial in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and sets up back-markers
scenarios.body: Fiskardo's recent Perth win suggests he retains ability and the tongue-tie addition could unlock improvement. The soft ground suits his profile and he can benefit from a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If The Flaggy Shore goes too slowly and it becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of raw speed rather than stamina, potentially suiting a fresh horse. However, this seems unlikely given The Flaggy Shore's tactical awareness shown in Listed company.

watchPoints.text: Kenobi has been pulled up or tailed off in hurdles and could compromise the race if struggling early
The Flaggy Shore's 74-day break since his last run could affect his sharpness despite his class edge
Fiskardo carries the tongue-tie that helped him win at Perth and could show marked improvement
One Knight disappointed badly in Grade 2 company last time and needs to bounce back to bumper form
Brenda Lady makes her hurdles debut with no established running style, creating tactical uncertainty

races.name: Happy 1st Birthday Idris Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Green Asset
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with improved recent form who can benefit from tracking the early leaders without doing the donkey work.
runners_data.comment: Improved second over 2m5f at Newton Abbot and he looks ready for this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: An improved clear second over 2m5f at Newton Abbot last month and he looks ready for this longer trip; should run well.

runners_data.name: Blackacre
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist wearing new visor but poor hurdles record means he needs everything to fall right with the pace.
runners_data.comment: Two chase wins last August but hasn't looked well treated since then; 0-11 as a hurdler
runners_data.spotlight: In a new visor he won two 3m2f handicap chases at Newton Abbot last August; has looked too high in the weights since then and he's 0-11 as a hurdler; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Hard Stare
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner but poor hurdles form suggests he may not have the class to make his early advantage count.
runners_data.comment: Yet to get anything going over hurdles and was beaten 25l on his handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in bumpers but has yet to get anything going over hurdles and was beaten 25l on his handicap debut at Taunton (3m, good; 6-1).

runners_data.name: Glenmuick
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up to 3 miles for the first time with cheekpieces added after rallying second here last month.
runners_data.comment: His first run at 3m and in cheekpieces when a rallying second here a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: His first run at 3m and in cheekpieces when a rallying second here a month ago (good); may well have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Poet's Muse
runners_data.note: Front runner with best recent form who was narrowly beaten on handicap debut and has point-to-point stamina foundation.
runners_data.comment: First worthwhile run under rules when beaten a head on her handicap debut at Taunton
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner; first worthwhile run under rules when beaten a head on her handicap debut at Taunton (3m, good) and that's something to build on; went up 2lb and Paddy Hanlon takes off 5lb this afternoon, so she's weighted to have a say.

runners_data.name: Good Girl Rachel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades in the finish and looks vulnerable over this stamina-stretching trip despite the headgear.
runners_data.comment: This longer trip is probably a good move for her handicap debut; tries cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 6l in one of her points; pretty much tailed off in her three maiden/novice hurdles (2m-2m3f) but this longer trip is probably a good move for her handicap debut; tries cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Crest Of Valour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut with tongue-tie added after disappointing form, needs significant improvement.
runners_data.comment: Quiet so far but now makes handicap debut with a tongue-tie added
runners_data.spotlight: It's been underwhelming stuff thus far but he's treated accordingly for this handicap debut and a tongue-tie is added; entitled to show more.

runners_data.name: Alderley Charlie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades in finish with poor recent form figures, even tongue-tie addition unlikely to transform him.
runners_data.comment: Never took to fences and never counted on his return to hurdles at Exeter; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Form figures of PFPP over fences and, with a tongue-tie added, he never counted on his return to hurdles at Exeter; opposable.

races.paceDynamic: Poet's Muse and Hard Stare will dispute the early lead in this novice handicap hurdle, with both confirmed front runners likely to set a solid gallop over the 3-mile trip. Green Asset and Glenmuick will track prominently behind the leaders, while the hold-up horses Blackacre and Alderley Charlie will settle towards the rear on the testing soft ground. The sustained pace from two keen leaders over this stamina-stretching distance will create a genuine test, particularly given the energy-sapping conditions. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close to the pace without doing the donkey work, as both leaders may weaken after their early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Green Asset or Glenmuick can track the early leaders without getting embroiled in their battle
scenarios.body: The solid early pace will soften up both Poet's Muse and Hard Stare, allowing the patient prominent runners to strike in the final half-mile. Green Asset's improved recent form and Glenmuick's first-time cheekpieces give them the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Muse can dictate terms and kick clear of Hard Stare before the home turn
scenarios.body: Her narrow defeat at Taunton suggests she has the stamina for this trip, and if she can dispose of Hard Stare early, she may have enough left to hold off late challengers. The mare's point-to-point background provides the foundation for this sustained effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between the leaders becomes suicidal and burns them out completely
scenarios.body: The soft ground and 3-mile distance would play perfectly into Blackacre's hands, allowing him to pick up the pieces despite his poor hurdles record. His chase-winning form at Newton Abbot proves he has the stamina when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Poet's Muse and Hard Stare disappoint and fail to set any meaningful gallop
scenarios.body: A messy, slowly-run affair would turn this into a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most. Green Asset's superior recent RPR figures would make him very hard to beat in such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Hard Stare and Poet's Muse go too fast early as this could set up the race for patient types like Green Asset and Blackacre.
Monitor Glenmuick's jumping over this longer trip as he steps up to 3 miles for the first time with new cheekpieces.
Observe how the soft ground affects the stamina reserves in the final half-mile as several runners have question marks over the trip.
Check if Blackacre can overcome his poor 0-11 hurdles record as the visor and longer trip may unlock improvement.
Watch for any market support for Crest Of Valour making his handicap debut with tongue-tie as the yard is out of form.

races.name: Francky Du Berlais Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hell Hound
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent chase win confidence but 6lb higher in the weights and 49 days since last run could blunt his edge
runners_data.comment: Southwell winner; fair shout off 6lb higher but might not appreciate too much rain
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner who won on only his second run over fences at Southwell (3m, good), cosily by 3l; good chance off 6lb higher but might not appreciate too much rain (good to soft would be acceptable).

runners_data.name: Axel Bleue
runners_data.note: Prominent style but concerning recent form with two pull-ups, though trainer Mickey Bowen hitting 8% strike rate recently
runners_data.comment: Could appreciate returning to a handicap but current wellbeing is a bit of an issue
runners_data.spotlight: Point and dual bumper winner in 2025; runner-up in two 2m7f novice hurdles in October but pulled up on handicap debut the next month and again ran moderately on his return, albeit back in a novice.

runners_data.name: Loki's Mischief
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse perfectly suited to this tactical setup, fresh from victory here just 15 days ago over similar trip
runners_data.comment: His second run over fences when doing it fairly comfortably here two weeks ago (2m5f)
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over hurdles; only his second run over fences when doing it fairly comfortably here two weeks ago (2m5f, good; fine on softer) and he promises to stay this far; every chance off a 6lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Jack's Jury
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with 7lb pull with Loki's Mischief from their recent meeting and proven soft ground form
runners_data.comment: Under 4l behind Loki's Mischief over 2m5f here recently and 7lb better off with the winner
runners_data.spotlight: 1-13 over hurdles; didn't go unbacked on chase debut when beaten under 4l by Loki's Mischief over 2m5f here recently and he's 7lb better off with the winner; clear claims.

races.paceDynamic: Hell Hound will take them along at a sustainable tempo with Axel Bleue likely to track close behind, creating a moderate gallop in this small field. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will be manageable rather than searching, allowing the field to stay in touch throughout. With only four runners and no confirmed tearaway leaders, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver late challenges. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up performers who can unleash finishing kicks over the final few fences.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Hell Hound and Axel Bleue setting reasonable fractions.
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Loki's Mischief and Jack's Jury will prove decisive as they can quicken when it matters most over the final half-mile. Both hold-up horses are perfectly positioned to exploit the tactical race this will become.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Control
scenarios.trigger: If Hell Hound and Axel Bleue increase the tempo significantly from halfway and maintain their advantage.
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners stretch the small field and their superior stamina reserves allow them to hold off late challenges from the closers. Hell Hound's recent win and Axel Bleue's hurdle form prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hell Hound Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Hell Hound takes a commanding lead early and the others allow him too much rope.
scenarios.body: His recent confidence boost from winning at Southwell carries him through as the pace becomes too searching for the hold-up horses to make up the ground. The 3-mile trip suits his staying power perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all four runners go extremely slowly in the early stages creating a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of speed rather than stamina, potentially suiting whichever horse has the sharpest turn of foot regardless of running style. Jack's Jury's hurdle speed could prove the difference in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Hell Hound could struggle to repeat his Southwell win after 49 days off and facing a 6lb penalty
Axel Bleue's recent pull-ups suggest potential fitness or attitude concerns that could resurface
Loki's Mischief's quick return after just 15 days may indicate connections are confident about his wellbeing
Jack's Jury needs to reverse recent form with Loki's Mischief despite receiving 7lb compensation
The small field of four means any early mistake or jumping error will be extremely costly

races.name: Adept GRP Cabinets Mares' Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Bridget Mary
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course and distance win last month, proven on soft ground and holds clear class edge over most rivals here.
runners_data.comment: Left clear here a month ago but she did hold every chance at the time; raised only 2lb
runners_data.spotlight: Went very close at Chepstow (2m7f) before gifted the race over C&D last month when left clear late on; she did hold every chance at the time anyway and has gone up only 2lb.

runners_data.name: Just A Memory
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but 117 days off worrying, though her September win shows she has the ability when fit and well.
runners_data.comment: Has won over fences but no positives to take from her last three races
runners_data.spotlight: Narrowly won small-field 2m5f handicap chase for Tom Ellis last September but her next two runs (3m2f, hurdle/chase) were very disappointing, as was her stable debut in January (hurdling); no headgear this afternoon; a bit risky.

runners_data.name: O'Grady's Hill
runners_data.note: Natural front runner but poor recent form is major concern despite trainer's improved 14-day strike rate suggesting preparation.
runners_data.comment: Beaten between 15l and 58l in seven starts for this yard, six of those handicap chases
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten between 15l and 58l in seven starts for this yard, six of those handicap chases; the blinkers did nothing last time.

runners_data.name: Lynsey Larue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with point-to-point background ideal for this stamina test, tongue-tie fitted after disappointing Ludlow effort.
runners_data.comment: Second at Warwick before a lesser show at Ludlow; tongue-tie could make a difference
runners_data.spotlight: Dual point winner; it was only her fourth run over fences when second at Warwick (3m, soft) and she could rebound from her Ludlow run now fitted with a tongue-tie; hard to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Shesupincourt
runners_data.note: Prominent style horse but mounting losing run and big defeats recently are red flags despite versatile ground action.
runners_data.comment: Losing run is mounting up, as are a string of big defeats
runners_data.spotlight: Losing run is mounting up, as are a string of big defeats; has won over hurdles and fences but she needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Fox Wallace
runners_data.comment: Has lost her way badly since her win/place form over fences last summer
runners_data.spotlight: Has lost her way badly since her win/place form over fences last summer; cheekpieces tried last time are swiftly removed; couldn't trust.

runners_data.name: Miss Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare needing strong pace which seems unlikely with limited front runners, plus poor recent form over hurdles last week.
runners_data.comment: She finished well behind over hurdles last week after a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: Went close at Bangor early last year and was placed again next time; however, her form ran cold afterwards and she finished well behind over hurdles last week after a layoff.

races.paceDynamic: Fox Wallace and O'Grady's Hill are the confirmed front runners, but Fox Wallace is a non-runner, leaving O'Grady's Hill as the likely sole pace-setter with Bridget Mary, Just A Memory, Lynsey Larue and Shesupincourt all holding prominent positions behind. With only one natural leader remaining, the pace will be steady rather than contested, allowing the field to stay in touch longer. The soft going and 3m trip will test stamina reserves in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and have the class to outstay rivals when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bridget Mary Controls
scenarios.trigger: If the class horse settles well tracking O'Grady's Hill and stays the trip on testing ground.
scenarios.body: Her recent Ffos Las win shows she handles the course and conditions perfectly, while her higher class rating should tell when others weaken. She can dictate from the front group and pull clear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and steady pace creates a gruelling stamina examination in the final mile.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true staying test where experience and proven stamina count most, favouring horses with point-to-point backgrounds. Lynsey Larue's dual point wins and Shesupincourt's versatility could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: O'Grady's Hill Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner gets an easy lead and maintains it longer than expected on the testing ground.
scenarios.body: With no pressure from other pace-setters, O'Grady's Hill could dictate at her own tempo and prove hard to peg back despite her poor recent form. Her trainer's decent 14-day record suggests she's primed for improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Miss Pearl Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up mare gets the strong pace and stamina test her style requires.
scenarios.body: The soft ground and genuine gallop would set up perfectly for Miss Pearl's patient tactics, allowing her to conserve energy and finish strongly when others tire. Her past Bangor form suggests she has the ability when conditions align.

watchPoints.text: Watch O'Grady's Hill in the market as any significant support would suggest stable confidence despite her terrible recent form string.
Monitor Just A Memory for signs of fitness after 117 days absence, as she needs to be spot-on to justify her prominent market position.
Watch how Bridget Mary travels in the early stages as she can get keen, and any pulling could compromise her stamina reserves.
Check if Lynsey Larue's tongue-tie helps her settle better than at Ludlow where she disappointed after travelling well early.
Observe the pace through the first mile as a slow tempo would compromise Miss Pearl's hold-up tactics significantly.

races.name: Adept GRP Cabinets Mares' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: La Belle Argentee
runners_data.note: Prominent runner forced into unwanted lead role without Miss Tiara, plus concerning wind operation and poor recent handicap form
runners_data.comment: Few positives to take from her first three handicaps (2m-2m4f); had a wind operation
runners_data.spotlight: Few positives to take from her first three handicaps (2m-2m4f), the latest on first run since leaving Dan Skelton; had a wind operation.

runners_data.name: Miss Tiara
runners_data.comment: Signs in her last two races that she's found her level; drops back from 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Had three runs since a wind operation; signs in her last two races that she's found her level, beaten under 7l in 3m handicaps at Taunton; this trip might be a better fit; considered.

runners_data.name: Kates Choice
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who fell here recently but showed promise when second at Exeter, though was well beaten
runners_data.comment: 25l off the winner when second two runs back; fell early here two weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: It was her first placing when runner-up at Exeter (2m, good) but she was some 25l off the winner; fell early here two weeks ago; has enough to prove on balance, though she does probably stay this far.

runners_data.name: Freddiemissmolli
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 154-day break with new trainer and hood, but has fading tendencies in finish
runners_data.comment: New trainer fits a hood for handicap debut on what's her first run since December
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper efforts were fairly promising but her hurdles runs less so; new trainer fits a hood for handicap debut on what's her first run since December; others safer.

runners_data.name: Jlow
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor 20-race maiden record who was pulled up last time at Warwick
runners_data.comment: 20-race maiden under both codes and did plenty wrong when pulled up last time
runners_data.spotlight: 20-race maiden under both codes and did plenty wrong when pulled up last time at Warwick (2m5f); opposable.

runners_data.name: Forest Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who could be sharper for recent C&D run after 187-day layoff, benefits from new cheekpieces
runners_data.comment: Dual AW winner; beaten 5.5l over C&D (good) a month ago on first run for 187 days
runners_data.spotlight: Dual AW winner; beaten 5.5l over C&D (good) a month ago on first run for 187 days and could be sharper for that outing, and benefit from the new cheekpieces; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Barafundle Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut after 174-day break with questionable hurdles form
runners_data.comment: Low-grade Flat winner in 2024; beaten 22l and 39l in her two runs over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner in 2024; beaten 22l and 39l in her two runs over hurdles and makes stable/handicap debut after a lengthy break; may need the ground good or quicker.

runners_data.name: Mya Du Clos
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare whose stamina is questionable after failing to stay 3m last time at Southwell
runners_data.comment: Perhaps failed to stay 3m on her handicap debut but she still has plenty to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Quiet at about 2m over hurdles before going up to 3m on handicap debut at Southwell, a trip she might not have stayed; she's still got plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Mystical Mabel

races.paceDynamic: Miss Tiara has been withdrawn as a non-runner, removing the only confirmed front runner from this field. With La Belle Argentee as the sole prominent runner among eight hold-up horses, this creates an extremely weak early pace scenario. The lack of natural pace-setters means the early gallop will be pedestrian, with La Belle Argentee likely forced into an unnatural leading role she doesn't want. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can overcome the slow early tempo with late acceleration over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Argentee reluctantly leads with no pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The tepid gallop becomes a sprint finish where the best late finishers can unleash their strongest kicks. Hold-up horses with proven finishing speed get maximum opportunity to demonstrate their superiority in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo Set
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Argentee commits to a stronger gallop from the outset
scenarios.body: She creates just enough pace to string out the field moderately, but still allows closers to mount challenges. The race becomes more tactical with positioning crucial in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Field Bunches Early
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses vie for the lead in Miss Tiara's absence
scenarios.body: An unexpected early battle develops as several hold-up horses get caught wide or forced forward. This creates genuine pace that could set up a different tactical dynamic entirely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Tactical Mess
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running and they crawl for 2 miles
scenarios.body: The race becomes farcical with a mad dash only in the final 4 furlongs. Whoever gets first run from the back has a crucial advantage in such chaotic circumstances.
